build: Tap the snow to put a block. Tap a block to stack one more on top!
erase: Eraser! Tap a block to take it away.
door: A door block! Put it in your wall, so you can go inside.
needdoor: Great walls! Now put in a door block.
ready: Your igloo is ready! Tap the door to go inside!
in: You are inside your igloo! Tap a thing, then tap where it goes.
paint: Pick a colour, then tap a wall!
nope: That does not fit there. Try another spot!
sel: Turn it, move it, or put it back in the bag.
tired: Tap the arrow to go back to the map.
walk: Tap the snow to walk. Tap an animal to say hello!
hungry_dog: This husky is hungry. Tap the fish!
hungry_seal: The seal is hungry. Tap the fish!
fox_hi: Shh! A fox! Tap the camera to take photos.
yum: Yum yum! Thank you! Here is a coin for your help.
nofish: No fish left! Take the sled to the fish camp to get more.
f_husky1: Huskies have two coats of fur, so they stay warm in the snow.
f_husky2: Huskies love to run. They can pull a sled for a long, long way!
f_husky3: When huskies sleep, they curl up and cover their nose with their fluffy tail.
f_seal1: Seals have a thick layer of fat called blubber. It keeps them warm in icy water.
f_seal2: Seals can hold their breath and swim under the ice!
f_fox1: Arctic foxes turn white in winter, so they can hide in the snow.
f_fox2: An arctic fox can hear tiny animals moving under the snow.
photo_start: Watch the fox. When it does something new, tap the camera!
photo_same: You have that one. Wait for something new!
photo_done: Three fox photos! Here is a fox picture for your igloo, and two coins.
aur_start: It is night! Paint the northern lights with your finger. Or just tap the sky!
aur_done: Wow! Look at your northern lights glowing in the sky!
f_aurora: Northern lights happen when tiny bits from the sun make the air glow, high up in the sky.
sled_feed: The dogs are hungry. Tap each bowl to feed them. Then tap go!
dogs_ready: All the dogs are happy and strong! Tap go!
dogs_slow: Hungry dogs run slowly. Next time, feed them first!
mush: Let's go! Follow the yellow arrow to the fish camp.
wrong_way: Oh no! This way has thin ice and no fish. We have to turn around!
turn_around: An ice wall! Hold an arrow to turn the sled around.
load_fish: The fish camp! Tap the fish to put them on the sled.
fish_home: Now take the fish home to the camp! Follow the arrow.
trip_done: You brought the fish home! Three fish for the animals, and three coins!
f_igloo: Did you know? Snow has lots of tiny air pockets, so an igloo keeps the warm air inside.
shop_hi: The trading post! Use your coins to get things for your igloo.
count6: One, two, three, four, five, six!
need_more: You need a few more coins. Feed the animals or take the sled to earn more!
bought: It's yours! You can find it inside your igloo.
drill_start: Hold the drill button to make a hole in the ice!
hole_done: You made a hole! Now tap the fishing rod.
fish_cast: Tap the fishing rod to drop your line.
fish_wait: Wait for the float to wiggle...
caught: You caught a fish! Fish are food for the animals.
bag_empty: Your bag is empty. Visit the trader to buy things for your igloo!
count1: One! It's yours! You can find it inside your igloo.
sold: Thank you! One fish, one coin!
dome: Your walls are two blocks high! Watch, the roof builds itself!
dome_done: Ta-da! Your igloo has a round snow roof!
dome_gone: Oh! A wall got too low, so the roof came down. Build it back up!
closet_hi: Your backpack! Drag clothes onto you.
closet_empty: No clothes yet. Buy warm clothes at the trading post with your coins.
clothes_got: New clothes! Open your backpack to put them on.
spark_cant: I can't answer questions just yet. Let's explore the Arctic together!
spark_listen: What do you want to know?
spark_hmm: Hmm, I didn't hear that. Tap me and try again!
roof_hint: Build your walls two blocks high all around, and you get a roof!
ring_hint: Make a ring of snow walls, with empty snow inside.
